C1325.title: Shadow AI Drives Average Data Breach Cost Up by $670,000
C1325.summary: An IBM report finds that data breaches involving AI cost enterprises over $650,000 on average. A single breach linked to shadow AI costs $670,000 more than a standard data breach and takes 247 days to detect, highlighting the severe financial and security impact of unauthorized AI use.
